messages:
natalie: Heads-up: we've got reports that some tenants are still getting v1 responses even after console shows 'migrated to v2'. Customers hit subtle schema mismatch. Example payload attached.

natalie: sample response body:
```
{"model_version":"v1","choices":[{"text":"old-format","meta":{}}]}
```

chris: omg. is this the pin/unpin race?

devon: maybe. earlier change: console unpins route when tenant completes migration, but backend route-cache has a TTL of 5m and our routing priority favors pinned entries during that TTL. if unpin happens while cache still has pin, client could still be routed to v1.

priya: timeline: customer A flipped migration toggle at 11:02 UTC, console shows migrated, but logs show a routed v1 request at 11:03:22 (trace trc-20240404-11).

natalie: can we reproduce? steps?

chris: quick repro idea:
1) set tenant feature flag migration.completed = true
2) immediately send requests from a client that doesn't set X-Route header
3) observe route in router.trace or /debug/route?trace=...

priya: I can repro locally with harness. confirms stale pin in route-cache.

devon: root cause: unpin writes to console + enqueues cache invalidation job, but job is processed async and sometimes drops if router instance is under GC. should be synchronous invalidation or strong eventual consistency fix.

natalie: mitigation options?

chris: short-term:
- force a sync cache invalidation on migration toggle (hotfix)
- console: show a small "migration pending invalidation" badge instead of final migrated state until we confirm cache eviction

devon: medium-term:
- change router cache to listen on config-change stream (push) instead of polling/queue
- add per-tenant route epoch version so routing decisions compare epoch in request vs cached epoch

priya: telemetry asks:
- add metric: routing.pin_stale_evictions per-tenant
- track count of requests routed_to_version != console_shown_version

ops-bot: alert created: https://ops.redwood.example/ALRT-1122 if routing.pin_stale_evictions > 10 for a tenant in 10m

natalie: docs + support messaging: we need copy for customers explaining brief migration window and recommended client-side header to pin v2 immediately (X-Route: v2). @devon can you draft snippet?

devon: draft snippet:
"To avoid brief inconsistency during migration, set header: `X-Route: v2`. This guarantees server-side routing to v2 while invalidations propagate"

docs-bot: FYI: added a migration note draft to internal docs: https://docs.redwood.example/migration-v2#pin-linger

chris: deployment plan for hotfix:
- patch console backend to call /router/invalidate?tenant=... synchronously on toggle
- add UI state change: migrated -> eviction_pending -> migrated_confirmed once router acknowledges
- smoke test in staging, then canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%

natalie: prioritize hotfix. assign owners?

chris: I'll own backend invalidate PR. devon owns router ack endpoint and cache handler. priya will own telemetry/alerting and will add dashboards. docs-bot: can you unblock customer-facing copy once devon sends final header text?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window 02:30 UTC tomorrow.

priya: I'll add a dashboard panel: Route mismatch rate, and set threshold to 0.1% over 5m to raise an ops pager.

natalie: billing impact: unlikely but cc finance if any elevated token/rate anomalies from retries.

devon: one more ask: add a small request-level debug header in router responses when route != console_version: `X-Routing-Diff: v1->v2` so support can quickly triage.

chris: agreed. small header behind feature-flag debug.routing_diff. default off for prod.

natalie: OK timeline: patch PRs today, staging smoke tonight, canary tomorrow. I'll post progress in #release-war-room. thanks all.
